decisions.claim: B is looking to rent an apartment
decisions.reason: Turn 5 'Are you renting it alone or with company?' directly presupposes B is renting an apartment.

decisions.claim: B is interested in a one-bedroom apartment
decisions.reason: Turn 7 explains what a one-bedroom apartment is, strongly suggesting B asked about or expressed interest in one. Genuine E2 presupposition from context.

decisions.claim: B is looking for an apartment with a particular type in mind
decisions.reason: Turn 3 is an open question ('Do you have any particular type in mind?') that does NOT presuppose B has a particular type. Questions do not establish their answers.
decisions.counterexample: B may have no particular type in mind and is asking for options.

decisions.claim: B is arranging to view the apartment on Friday morning
decisions.reason: Turn 13 'Would Friday morning be alright?' presupposes a viewing/meeting arrangement is being discussed. Genuine E2 presupposition.

decisions.claim: B is looking for an apartment to rent
decisions.reason: c5 'B is looking for an apartment to rent' is equivalent to c1 'B is looking to rent an apartment.' c1 is more complete and directly E1.

decisions.claim: B expressed interest in a one-bedroom apartment
decisions.reason: c6 'B expressed interest in a one-bedroom apartment' is equivalent to c2 'B is interested in a one-bedroom apartment.' c2 is the cleaner representative.

decisions.claim: B asked whether the apartment has a specific appliance (likely a washing machine or dishwasher)
decisions.reason: Turn 9 'No, but a fridge and a stove' presupposes B asked about an appliance not present. The specific appliance is inferred (E3), but the fact B asked about an appliance is E2.

decisions.claim: B asked about lease duration and rental cost
decisions.reason: Turn 11 'Yes, it's a one-year lease. And $200 a week...' presupposes B asked about lease duration and cost. Genuine E2.

decisions.claim: B is arranging a viewing or meeting with A for Friday morning
decisions.reason: c9 'B is arranging a viewing or meeting with A for Friday morning' is equivalent to c4 'B is arranging to view the apartment on Friday morning.' c4 is the cleaner representative.

decisions.claim: B called Venus Real Estate Agency
decisions.reason: Turn 1 'Good morning. Venus Real Estate Agency.' is a standard business greeting, presupposing B called the agency. Genuine E2 presupposition from conversational structure.

decisions.claim: B is renting an apartment (the apartment has a one-year lease at $200 a week with one month refundable deposit)
decisions.reason: c11 'B is renting an apartment' is equivalent to c1 'B is looking to rent an apartment' in substance. The lease details are already captured in c8. c1 is the cleaner representative.
